notes:
Inbound via blog post about low-latency streaming. Self-serve signup converted to discovery lead. Founder/CTO: Lina Moss (ex-search infra). Fast-moving small product team. Primary app: in-app assistant embedded in their SaaS product for SMB customers (support + workflow guidance).

Key quotes: "Users expect near-immediate replies inside our app — p50 needs to feel instant; p95 under 300ms would be huge." CTO asked about streaming + token-level costs.

Requirements summary (from initial convo): prefer public cloud, want streaming responses with partial tokens delivered to client; p50 latency target ~80-150ms for short prompts (~50 tokens); throughput modest (100-250 concurrent users at peak), bursty during onboarding flows; cost-sensitive — interested in token-efficient prompts and suggestion on batch/cache settings.

Model preferences: open models first (compatibility with Llama-family or other quantized variants) but open to Redwood curation. Must support streaming and function/tool-calling for structured slot filling.

Security/compliance: SSO for admin console (SAML), audit logs for API usage, retention controls for customer transcripts. Data residency not strict yet but they asked about EU region availability for EU customers.

Eng notes: team already spun up PoC; hit a latency spike when they tried local batching. They want advice on autoscaling and smart routing to avoid cold-starts. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization.

Lead behaviour: very responsive, engineering-first, prefers code examples and quick perf numbers over product marketing. Happy to try free credits and a sandboxed workload.
